notes.title: v2.2.1-EA Patch notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! Today we have released Enzio-Ware v2.2.1-EA! (Not to be confused with 2.2.-1-EA, this one is not a negative release)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051224/caf1979d75398157603035ea54686ec07dbe660a.png"][/img][/p][h1]Feature Preview: Magicshop[/h1][p]First there were barbershops, then beautyshops, now Hecate has pioneered a brand new invention: [b]the Magicshop[/b]! (please don’t kill me if barbershops came second)[/p][p]
[/p][p]The Magicshop is a new addition to the accessories application on the Enzio-System. Using it, [b]you can customize your very own Enzio-System[/b]!! Either use the in-game tools, or import one you make yourself using the template linked below! Please follow the TOS.[/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1N_mDe8oOBQuVbEV5p7hgKSikAMJUinlL?usp=sharing" style="button" buttoncolor="#c737fb"]ES Template[/url][/p][p]
[/p][p]Using In-Game tools, you color and paint on the system and buttons individually. You have access to a simple pen-brush, alongside stickers of the various treasures and commemorative photos you’ve collected![/p][p][/p][p]Using the external template, we have provided all layers, but at the end we’ll only ask you for the collapsed open+closed images. Enzio-Systems using the external templates are not limited to the bound the ones made in-game are. Be creative, but please keep in-mind this can lead to unintended behaviors.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]This is currently a preview and not the final state of this feature. [/b]In addition to Steam Workshop support, I also eventually want to allow you to set an open/close sound. The in-game drawing application will also have a color history, I can’t promise undo/redo though.[/p][p][/p][p]Stylus and Theme creation will also get added later on if everything goes well with ES creation. [/p][h2]Magicshop FAQ [/h2][list][*][p]Does Magicshop support Steam Workshop?[/p][list][*][p][b]In the future we will add Steam Workshop support.[/b] This was only implemented now because I knew I could do it in about a day.[/p][/*][*][p]For now, to share your creations, navigate to “[b]%localappdata%low\\Team PLC Games\\Enzio-Ware 2.0”[/b] in your file system, and find the folder your creation is in.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]How many custom Enzio-System skins can I have?[/p][list][*][p]As many as your computer can hold in memory on the selection screen probably.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Microgame Additions[/h1][list][*][p]Added “Parkour” to Arthur’s episode[/p][list][*][p]All the information you need is on the task[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Ambassador Certificate Additions[/h1][list][*][p]Ambassador's have access to exactly one exclusive sticker in the Magicshop, more are coming eventually (alongside the retired DMV items and items intended for 2.2.0-EA) sorry about the delay on that. [/p][/*][/list][h1]Audio Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Jordan remastered all the tracks, and the old versions have been swapped out! We will work on rebalancing audio in future patches[/p][/*][*][p]Enzio-Pon now has its own theme![/p][/*][/list][h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1][list][*][p]“J” can now be used in some places where "Space" is requested. I implemented this because my space key is shotty.[/p][/*][/list][h1]What’s Next?[/h1][p]Current goal: all characters at 10 microgames by the end of September, and potentially all characters updated. As I thought, my laptop wasn’t sufficient enough to work on Enzio-Ware, and my vacation ended up being more of a move. I have my PC back now and Ava’s made most of the backgrounds I needed for Hecate and Jud, so expect them updated soon!![/p][p]The epilogue is delayed indefinitely (not because of Silksong it’s just realistically not going to release this month lol). I’m still trying to keep our original promise of releasing the full game before December, but what may end up happening is me releasing the epilogue (hopefully) on-time and holding off on transitioning out of Early Access until we polish up other areas.[/p][p]
[url="https://forms.gle/pip5iHbqnJDKVgjw8" style="button" buttoncolor="#335240"]Feedback Form[/url][/p]

notes.title: Enzio-Ware v2.2.0.0-EA Full Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Today we have released Enzio-Ware v2.2.0.0-EA! That’s right! No more negative version numbers! This update still is missing sound for stuff (it is being actively worked on now) but that was for the sake of not delaying this update any further![/p][p]Our original promise was that 2.2.0-EA would update Carmy and Kendra to the new cutscene system, [b]however[/b] we actually had everything necessary to update Arthur and Polly too!! Surprise!! [/p][p][b][u]These patch notes cover some aspects of the previously released negative-numbered 2.2.0-EA versions to make sure all bases are covered. Such things are denoted in underlined text[/u][/b][/p][p]
[/p][h1]Cutscene Revisions[/h1][p]Carmy, Arthur, Kendra, and Polly’s cutscenes now use the visual-novel style cutscene system. All of these cutscenes mostly play out like the old versions, but with new narration and revised dialogue, as with Sam’s, these will likely continue to see touch-ups in future updates.[/p][p][u]Kendra’s revised intro was already present in Enzio-Ware v2.2.-1-EA:01, but has seen some modifications, including additional dialogue and new backgrounds.[/u][/p][h3]Disclaimer for Polly’s Episode!![/h3][p]Polly’s narration has [i]in-canon[/i] been poorly translated by an AI. In reality we just took the English script and [b]manually edited it[/b] to make it sound like a machine translation. I think it’s obvious, but I wanted to make it clear in case it wasn’t, as the alternative would be people thinking we used AI for it.[/p][p]In a future update, you’ll be able to make [b]a certain character[/b] cast a spell to allow you to play this episode with an intelligible narration. For now though, we want to present the bit as is.[/p][h1]PLC-Dia Revamp![/h1][p][u]The PLC-Dia revamp was added in 2.2.-1-EA:01RE.[/u][b] [/b]The PLC-Dia was overhauled to allow for easier scrolling and a better visual presentation. The PLC-Dia was also rebalanced to have treasure entries maxed out at 20 instead of 140! Alongside this, a slew of new treasures were added.[/p][p]In v2.2.0-EA, we have revised Carmy’s entry for “Nihil: The Visual Novel” to better reflect that game’s mechanics.[/p][h1]Cloud Save Changes[/h1][p]These changes were made in 2.2.-1-EA:01RE. Your cloud save is no longer pulled from, and will be re-worked into a backup feature you can opt to manually download. The cloud save IS still saved to, and if you need that backup for whatever reason you can email us or contact us on bluesky.[/p][h1]QOL Features and Changes[/h1][p][b][u]The following changes were made in 2.2.-1-EA.[/u][/b][/p][p][i][u]Brief Mode was added to freeplay[/u][/i][u].[/u] It allows you to play the microgames in a brief elevator transition that significantly reduces the time spent in-between microgames. Please use this if you don’t want the characters yapping in high-score runs.[/p][p][i][u]Cloud Content Delivery Was Removed[b].[/b][/u][b] [/b][/i]Cloud content delivery enabled us to add cosmetics and alter certain assets on the fly, but was ultimately never used. We removed this as it was adding a 1GB download to your first launch of the game and was truly not needed. Be aware that has resulted in an increased file size.[/p][p][i][u]Use the GameYarrk to aid in progression.[/u] [/i]You can now enable the GameYarrk in story mode to playthrough with unlimited lives. This should allow you to reach further episodes if earlier ones seem bugged or unfair. Please use it liberally as we figure things out.[/p][h1]Microgame Additions[/h1][p]Version 2.2.0-EA has added 2 new microgames to Polly’s episode.[/p][list][*][p]“Visitor”[/p][list][*][p]Protect Polly’s SOUL from a UFO’s “attack”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]“Break Room”[/p][list][*][p]Polly visits Sam in the breakroom...[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b][u]The following microgames were added in 2.2.-1-EA.[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]“Protect Arthur” has been re-added to 2.0![/p][list][*][p]Punch a crawdad to save Arthur from misery.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]“Tune In” has been added to Sam’s Episode! [/p][list][*][p]Tune the antennas correctly in-time to catch Sam’s favorite show![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]“Sink” has been added to Hecate’s Episode![/p][list][*][p]If you didn’t take Calculus it’s not my fault![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]“Bad Tomato” has been added to Hecate’s Episode![/p][list][*][p]It's exactly what you think it is[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]“Hypnotize” has been added to Hecate’s Episode![/p][list][*][p]The “Mesmerize” microgame will return eventually, but here’s another microgame based on the same thing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Feedback Form![/h2][p]You can now send anonymous feedback here [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/J6ssSGVPc334ybVj9"]https://forms.gle/J6ssSGVPc334ybVj9[/url][/p][p]. We meant to have this at launch but the google form link was requiring people sign in and have editing perms for some reason and we forgot to try again until now.[/p][h2]What’s next?[/h2][p]We are now working on Hecate/Jud/Enzio cutscene overhauls, and getting all characters to 10 microgames. [b]The epilogue will likely not hit its original goal of a September release[/b]. I apologize for this, but it just is not realistic at our current pace.[/p][p]We are also in the middle of reaching out to [i]an entity [/i]to make sure the current plan for the epilogue can be executed as intended, and certain aspects of it have to be put on hold until we get a response. Sorry for being cryptic about that, we don’t have a fanbase but I want to make sure that if we ever do it's not clear what this is about if we need to change course.[/p][p]I am going away for a couple weeks, and if my laptop fails to be sufficient enough to dev Enzio-Ware, I will attempt to dev a mobile spin-off game. This will only happen if I literally cannot do anything with Enzio-Ware so it's not eating at dev time, and other members of the team will still be doing Enzio-Ware related work.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Enzio-Ware v2.2.-1-EA:01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][i]Today we have released Enzio-Ware v2.2.-1-EA:01. To be clear, that is pronounced “version two point two point negative one dash Early Access colon zero one”; v2.2.0-EA will release properly at a later date[/i][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2025800/partnerevents/preview/"]Preview Event[/url][/p][h1]Cutscene Update[/h1][list][*][p]Kendra’s[b] INTRO[/b] cutscene has been updated to the new VN system. It is roughly 90% complete, barring a stock photo used in a background and will likely get its writing revised before 2.2.0’s proper release.[/p][list][*][p]Please be aware that Guy Bushell is an existing, recurring character and not a temporary stock photo. He was previously displayed silhouetted in this episode, and still appears silhouetted in episodes not yet converted to the new cutscene system.[/p][/*][*][p]If you’ve played the game before you may have already seen him lurking in a microgame or two[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051224/d00479900451a7f2cc83b39b0ab6ae47572e09e2.png"][/img](Preview of CG made for Enzio’s episode revision ft. Guy Bushell)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Visual Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Changed Mat (from the DMV)’s design, but it’s only actually visible in the PLC-dia.[/p][list][*][p]Cosmetics reflecting his old design have also been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]We will add the old versions back into the ambassador certificate at a later date (woulda been this update but I forgot).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed a font used in Enzio’s episode to “TikTok Sans”[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the visuals of the “Onwards! To The Furthest End!! Go Forth Supreme PLC!!!!” and “Enzio-Ware” to match the new physical boxarts we mocked-up for them.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]An issue where “Shout!” could be completed before the microgame actually started was fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h1]What’s Next?[/h1][p]Because of how long it’s taking 2.2.0 to be “done” we’re just gonna release things as soon as they’re ready, prepare for the version number to get even more convoluted. We still need to get the sound implemented for everything added last update and I’m sorry for how long that's taking. [/p][p]As for episode revisions: Basically all characters have had their updated portraits for the new cutscene system made. We’ve also decided to hold off on the CG for each episode for a bit, so (hopefully) episode revisions will trickle out way faster! We basically just need to make backgrounds and add the bottom screen narration for them all now.[/p][p]Also the soundtrack will be released soonish? We announced it on bluesky awhile back and never updated y’all on it. Basically Jordan wanted to remaster all the existing tracks, and he’s close to being done with that now. (You’ll hear ‘em in game sooner or later, I still need to go back and manually adjust the music source volumes now that we’ve removed the godforsaken normalization filter)[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Enzio-Ware v2.1.0-EA Release!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[b]Sam’s episode has been updated to use the revised cutscene system.[/b]
[*] The revised cutscene system features a more traditional visual novel layout, with multiple character portraits appearing at once.
[*] Both static backgrounds and CG are present in these cutscenes. In a future update, there will be a dynamic soundtrack.
[*] The revised cutscene system utilizes a fast forward instead of a full skip. The reason for this change is due to how the new cutscene engine handles changing scenes and granting items. Full skip will be re-implemented if this is an issue. 
[*] For now, the cutscene system still utilizes Animalese. In the future we may replace this with proper voice acting.
[*] Currently, if you “Fast Display” (idk what the standard term for showing all text at once without skipping lol) the dialogue box will stop playing sound. We will introduce a setting in a future update to allow the characters to also stop speaking when you do this.
[*] There is currently a bug where the portraits are floating slightly above the ES at some resolutions. We will try and have this fixed as soon as possible.
[/list]
[b]Added data needed for upcoming shop events[/b]
[b]Changed the Main Menu Theme. [/b]
[list]
[*] The music track “Default” has been updated to the new theme. 
[*] By launching the ambassador certificate, you can unlock the prior theme, now renamed to “Prove Lossy Courage”. “Prove Lossy Courage” is not exclusive to the ambassador certificate and will be available in shop rotations and other means in the future.   
[/list]
[b]Added in leaderboards.[/b]
[list]
[*] The leaderboard is made available after completing Sam’s episode. If you have already completed her episode, it will be available for you to add to the home menu after booting up the game.
[*] Currently, the plan is for leaderboards to not refresh. If the leaderboards become too static, we may introduce a monthly/weekly refresh system.
[*] The leaderboards utilize your account name and profile picture. 
[/list]
[b]Enzio-coins can now be used in Enzio-Pon machines to get certain treasures and cosmetics even when they are not in the current shop rotation.[/b]
[list]
[*] Enzio-Pon is made available after completing Sam’s episode. If you have already completed her episode, it will be available for you to add to the home menu after booting up the game.
[*] For now, the gachas are based around each main character’s episodes and unlocked after said episodes are completed. Not all cosmetics are available to obtain from the gachas at this time.
[*] Other methods of getting cosmetics outside of shop rotations will be introduced in future updates.
[*] As a reminder, Enzio-Coin is earned by playing microgames and cannot be purchased with real money. 
[*] 
[/list]

[h1][b]QOL Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Game speed can now be adjusted between 1x and 5x. Please be aware that some microgames may not be beatable at 5x.
[*] The player can now choose to disable the microphone by selecting “Disable Microphone” as their source.
[*] The player can now preview and adjust microphone sensitivity
[*] Music and SFX volume are now fully muted when the sliders are dragged all the way to the left in settings.
[*] The Game Version can now be seen in settings
[*] Background music stops playing when an episode has ended. When the episode is won this occurs after the curtains close, when the episode is lost, this occurs at the same time the loss jingle plays. We hope this will better communicate that an episode has ended.  
[/list]

[h1][b]New Achievements[/b][/h1]
We have added several new PLC-dia related achievements. These achievements are checked when you Launch the PLC-Dia, and can be obtained retro-actively. 
[list]
[*] “PLC Historian” was accidentally left visible. It is now actually set when the conditions are met. There are a total of 5 treasures needed for hits.
[*] “Har har har har har” has been added. 6 treasures are needed for this
[*] “Budding Collector” Collect 1 treasure
[*] “Experienced Collector” Collect 20 treasures
[*] “Professional Collector” Collect 50 Treasures
[*] “The Master Set” Collect all treasures. To account for the birthday treasures, this will be set if you have collected at least 96 treasures (the current number of non-birthday treasures).
[*] “Addicted to the Grind” Max out 1 treasure
[*] “Hyperfocus Win” Max out 5 treasures
[*] “Low-Key a Hoarder” Max out 50 treasures
[*] “ADHD VIP” Max out all treasures To account for the birthday treasures, this will be set if you have maxed out at least 96 treasures (the current number of non-birthday treasures).
[/list]
If by the time the final game releases they are deemed too unrealistic to get, “ADHD VIP” and “The Master Set” may have their thresholds lowered. We may also opt to lower the number of treasures needed to max out a treasure. There are still other game modes we are considering adding, so we are being cautious about lowering these numbers for now.
Several Freeplay-related achievements have also been added
[list]
[*] “I just wanted to see if it worked”
[*] “Double Time” get a score of 40 or more in freeplay
[*] “Double Double Time” get a score of 80 or more in freeplay
[*] “Four Twentys and 10” get a score of 90 or more in freeplay
[*] “Centennial” get a score of 100 or more in freeplay
[/list]
Centennial is currently the highest score that gives an achievement. If scores higher than that are achieved regularly, we will add in more.
Several Enzio-Pon achievements were added. You should be able to find them without help
Some more achievements were added
[list]
[*] “Honk” can be earned at some point in Jud’s episode
[*] “Keep Tapping” can be earned at some point in Enzio’s episode
[*] “Significantly Worse Than Mother” can be earned at some point in Carmy’s Episode
[*] “Sanity Low” can be earned at some point in Polly’s Episode
[*] “TAKE THAT VEGANS” can be earned at some point in Kendra’s episode
[/list]
We currently do not plan on adding leaderboard related achievements as they do not reset and would not be obtainable if we ever had to make the game offline only (no signs of that happening anytime soon tho)

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Microphone selection is now properly retrieved from the player’s save.
[*] Blowing on the mic should properly spin icons on the home menu again
[*] There is no longer a small sliver of the top screen peeking out when the ES is closed.
[*] The accessories screen now properly changes the screen closed image
[*] A specific achievement is no longer unintentionally triggered by losing one microgame in Jud’s episode
[/list]

[h1][b]Other Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the offline data for April’s shop rotations.
[*] Carmy’s cutscenes now pass the Bechdel test. (Some dialogue has changed, but she is still on the old Cutscene System)
[*] A plethora of new skins, taglines, themes, and icons have been added
[*] Several themes have had their accent colors updated, these were supposed to be changed prior to release and we forgot.
[/list]

[h1][b]What’s Next[/b][/h1]
We are not going to specify a date for the next major update at this time. The next major update will, at the bare minimum, convert Carmy and Kendra over to the new cutscene system. It will likely also focus on getting every character to 10 microgames.

In terms of non-major updates, an update will need to be released by the end of April to add in May’s offline shop data, and we will likely have smaller updates adding in more microgames, in addition to any necessary bug fixes.

We apologize for this update missing our original target of Mid-March, one of our team members got in a car accident. (She is fine now don’t worry)

Please feel free to send feedback or suggestions to us at either our bluesky account (https://bsky.app/profile/teamplcgames.com) or by emailing support@teamplcgames.com.

notes.title: Enzio-Ware V2.0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch aims to help with making sure players without microgames can play the game properly.

The following microgames will not be added to the rotation if a valid microphone is not detected:
-Can You Speak Up (Sam's Episode)
-Shout (Kendra's Episode)
-Bake (Carmy's Episode)
-Recital & Rewind VHS (Jud's Episode)
-Show You Joy (Polly's Episode)

These microgames will also no longer show up in Enzio's episode at all.

We believe that with the current patch, users without microphones and users who cannot connect to the remote config, should be able to play the game normally now.
 The root cause of the remote config issue has not been identified and we will continue to monitor bug reports. If any more issues arise they will be addressed as soon as possible.

notes.title: Enzio-Ware v2.0.2-EA Patch Notes

Hello everyone!

We have released a new patch for Enzio-Ware. This patch includes the following changes:

--Bug Fixes--
-Offline Mode should hopefully be booted into correctly now when the game fails to connect online
-Fixed an issue where a specific achievement was not set when conditions were met.

--Gameplay Changes--
